shape_units.scope: answer-body level-1 blocks whose heading first names a price term (造价/价款/鉴定/沉井/灌注桩/水泥/信息价…); party block, intro and closing not measured (D04/D08 bind here for lineage only); a level-1 block naming neither a price nor a penalty term is outside this unit and is not measured (R10)

answer-body level-1 blocks whose heading first names a penalty or delay term (违约金/利息/逾期付款/工期); closing request lines not measured (D05 binds here for lineage only); a level-1 block naming neither a price nor a penalty term is outside this unit and is not measured (R10)
shape_units.threshold_basis: underrun_only; no public or instruction length requirement exists, so there is no overrun arm (the Golden is a compressed reference the answering model never sees); the underrun arm keeps the declared floor of 400 characters in view

normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 Markdown lines or DOCX body paragraphs and table rows; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters, Markdown heading/list/emphasis marks and table pipes (cells joined by colon), remove all whitespace
money amounts with 元/万元/人民币/¥ and thousands separators to one canonical yuan token; trailing zeros dropped
dates YYYY年M月D日 / YYYY-M-D / YYYY.M.D to @YYYY-MM-DD and month dates YYYY年M月 / YYYY-M / YYYY.M to @YYYY-MM

heading levels: 一、 level 1, (一) level 2, 1. level 3, (1) level 4, Markdown # depth when unnumbered, bold-only short lines level 3; a numbered line ending in 。 and longer than 40 characters is body text
statute article numbers in Chinese or Arabic numerals to one article token §n
fold every declared gap marker into one gap token: a marked value earns no positive credit, is excluded from fabrication checks and from shape counting
quoted spans of 13 or more characters (“…”, "…", 「…」) are replaced by an ellipsis token so quoted contract text, appraisal text or the opponent's words never count as the author's assertion
zones: leading title, party-label (答辩人/被上诉人/上诉人/被答辩人/原审原告/原审被告) and party-continuation lines form the header; the body runs to the line starting 此致; the rest is the closing
shape counter: non-whitespace characters of body lines in a shape group after N01, excluding clauses containing a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: keyword spray: a raw line of eight or more short whitespace/comma fragments, a sentence of six or more short enumerated fragments, or a sentence with more than four distinct amounts or dates cannot be adopted

asserted clauses: a sentence with candidate markers is not adopted; a clause starting with a concessive/conditional marker is dropped; an opponent subject plus speech verb (上诉人/B公司/被答辩人/对方…认为/称/主张/辩称/提出的理由) drops the text up to a rebuttal marker in the same clause, or otherwise the rest of the sentence until a clause starting with a contrast marker (但/然而/事实上/对此); request binding (D05): a request verb (请求/恳请/望/请) whose own clause (after the last comma or colon) ends with an opponent subject 上诉人/B公司/被答辩人/对方/一审被告/原审被告 (optionally followed by 虽/亦/也/还/又/仍…) reports the opponent's request and is never the appellee's adverse request; the attribution object set is not closed to 理由/主张/意见/观点/抗辩 but also covers 命题/说法/表述/陈述/计算 (上诉人…提出的是同一个命题：… is the opponent's ground restated, not the appellee's); a sticky attribution ends at a clause that starts with a back-reference (该/此/上述/前述) and carries a rebuttal marker, because that clause is the appellee's own conclusion about the attributed claim; an opposing ground carried by a possessive noun phrase inside one clause ((上诉人|B公司|…)…的(理由|主张|观点|说法|抗辩|命题|表述|陈述|计算|论述|看法|定性)) is attributed exactly as a speech verb is, and the negation guard applies only to the verb branch, because a negation inside the attributed noun phrase (沉井系措施项目而非实体工程) is part of what is attributed.

local spans: each non-quoted body line of at most 900 characters with its heading chain (a heading line only under R13), and each lowest-level heading block (heading plus following body lines until the next heading) of at most 1600 characters; body lines under a heading that only summarises the appellant's grounds are a quoted zone; each normalized sentence keeps its own line text and the nearest heading of that line (heading context) for object binding where an item allows it; a line that R18 marks as a reproduction of the Materials yields no span and joins no block

pattern adoption: a positive or error pattern with a declared gap is not matched when the gap contains a negation (不/未/没有/并非/非/无/无需), and an error pattern is not adopted when a rejection token (错误/不准确/不能成立/缺乏依据/不合理/不当 but not 并无不当) follows it in the sentence

endorsement: 并无不当/并无不妥/正确/合理/有依据/应予维持/符合约定 etc. count only when not preceded within two characters by 不/未/没/缺乏/无/非/难以/欠 (fixed tokens 并无不当, 并不不当, 并无错误 always count); R14 extends adoption beyond the endorsement vocabulary (see R14); the set includes the short form 无误 of 并无错误 and the appellate form 不应再被推翻/撤销/改判, and the scoped conformity form 与…约定一致 beside 符合…约定; the bare token 一致 is not in the set, because it would let keyword spraying earn P12.

item decision: every span is scored; the highest full or partial span wins; a span that also adopts the item's contrary concession (D01 object, D02 or D03 pattern) earns nothing and, when no other span earns credit, the item is ambiguous
amount binding: an amount token within the stated window after 沉井…造价/价款/费用 or 水泥…调差/价差 is the stated figure for that object; ranges CAISSON [4,400,000, 4,440,000] and CEMENT [1,340,000, 1,360,000]
penalty start: 自/从@date…起 in a sentence naming 违约金/逾期付款 outside claim narration and retention-money interest; accepted 2021-08, 2021-08-19, 2021-08-20, 2021-10-14, 2021-10-15
party roles: 答辩人/被上诉人 must not resolve to B公司 alone and 上诉人/被答辩人 must not resolve to A公司 alone

shape groups: body lines are grouped by their level-1 heading, whose first price term (造价/价款/鉴定/沉井/灌注桩/旋喷桩/水泥土/水泥/信息价/组价/计价) or penalty term (违约金/利息/逾期付款/逾期支付/付款条件/工期) decides S01 or S02; a level-1 block naming neither is outside the declared scope of both shape units and is not measured; a body with no level-1 heading at all leaves both units ambiguous. an unclassifiable level-1 block does not void the whole measurement, because voiding it would let an answer escape the shape charge by adding an off-scope section

unsupported author-originated act: inside one adopted answer-body sentence, an act key from the frozen unsupported-act set matched with affirmative polarity. appraisal_procedure: 重新鉴定, 鉴定人出庭/质询, 双方或各方参与鉴定/勘验/查勘, 现场签证, 施工记录, 监理资料. delay_claim: an issuing verb (发出/提出/提起/递交/提交/主张/作出/送达) within 10 characters of (工期|逾期竣工|逾期)?违约通知/违约函 or (工期|逾期竣工|逾期)?索赔, so that the object is the occurrence of the act and not the bare noun. The act keys are frozen because neither material records them; polarity is read on the act, so 上诉人从未发出工期违约通知或索赔主张 is an affirmative assertion about the appellant's conduct and triggers. A deontic or future modal (应/可/将/会/需/须/宜/建议/有权) before the act in the same clause is a statement about what a party may or should do and is excluded. evidence: materials token counts over the whitespace-stripped corpus: 重新鉴定 0, 鉴定人 0, 出庭 0, 质询 0, 参与 0, 现场签证 0, 施工记录 0, 监理资料 0, 索赔 0, 违约通知 0; an act inside a clause whose verb reports what the opponent did NOT allege ((未|没有|并未|从未|亦未|均未) + 主张/称/声称/说明/提及/指出/表示/举证/证明/指明) is a statement about the opposing filing, checkable against it, not an adopted fact about the world, and does not trigger

intra-artifact contradiction on the appellant identity: the artifact adopts a sentence asserting 提起/提出/递交/提交上诉 bound to the appellee and also a sentence denying it of the appellee. Subject binding: a party token inside the appeal verb's own clause (text after the last comma, colon or semicolon) governs the verb; when that clause names no party the sentence topic governs, and a party introduced by a co-argument marker (与/和/同/跟/对/向/针对/就) is a counterparty, never the subject. Polarity is read on the same clause with 不服 removed. Both polarities must be adopted; one alone is not a contradiction. The materials fix B公司 as the sole appellant

isolated heading: a heading line (N04 level 1-4) is an evidence span only when it is read together with the body of its own section, that is when the section it opens - the lines after it down to the next heading of the same or a higher level - contains at least one non-heading body line. An isolated heading, a heading whose section holds only further headings, and a heading at the end of the body assert nothing and yield no span, so a document of headings with no argument under them earns no positive credit (04a section 1: 孤立标题/空章节 must score 0; 04a section 2: a heading may only proxy a closed reasoning result). A heading that does head an argument is unaffected: it still supplies heading-chain context to every body-line span under it and still opens its block span under R03

adoption of a position: besides an R05 endorsement token, a span adopts a position when an adoption verb is bound to the appellee and the span names the decision below ((答辩人|被上诉人|A公司|本方)…(支持|认可|赞同|援引并支持) together with 一审/原审/判决/认定), or when the span states that a named opposing ground fails ((该|上述|其|本|此|a folded quotation) + 理由/主张/请求/命题/抗辩/解释/说法/异议 … 不能成立/不能提出/不予采纳/没有依据/所排除/不具备条件/无从发生). The adoption marker may sit in the sentence, in the same line's lead-in, or in the heading the line sits under, all read through R02, because R03 declares those to be one local span; the ground-failure branch names three families rather than one phrase list - the ground fails on the merits (不能成立/不予采纳/没有依据…), the ground is outside what this instance may decide (不属于…审理范围/不在…范围内, the deferral stance), and the ground cannot stand together with the instrument or premise it rests on (不能并存/不能同时成立/归于无用/无适用余地/同一条款不能作此解释). The object guard still applies, so a bare rejection word still closes nothing. The adoption marker of P11 is read over the local span, as for P12, because R03 makes the span the unit of local evidence.

carrier title: the answer title may carry a bracketed qualifier of at most 8 characters (民事答辩状（二审）); such a line is still the header title, so the party block that follows it stays in the header zone (N08) and is not read as answer body

shared normalized fragments used by more than one item, so that an item's discriminating power sits in its object and scope guards rather than in any one wording: NO_EVIDENCE ((未|没有|并未|从未|均未|亦未) + 提供/提交/举示/出示/举出/拿出/列出/给出/指明 + 证据, or 未举证/未能举证证明/未尽举证责任) and NO_COUNTERCLAIM (both orders: 未…提起/提出…反诉 and 未…以反诉形式提出); 'A is not a precondition of B' covers the non-influence relation (A的责任是否成立不影响B的责任是否成立 / 不以…为前提 / 与…无关) with both objects required in the sentence; P10's relation also covers the object-mismatch form (其所规范的对象不是本案判付的款项 / 错置 / 并非同一款项) and P10's distinctness family also covers the contrast form (违约金的计算依据是逾期付款本身，而非逾期审核).

adopted error proposition: a deduction match that crosses a clause separator (，；：) is an accidental adjacency of two clauses and does not trigger; a match inside a reported-ground adjunct (以/凭/据 … 为由/据/依据/理由) states somebody else's ground and does not trigger; a request verb that is part of the noun 上诉请求/诉讼请求/反诉请求/变更请求 is not the appellee asking for anything; the reported-ground test is clause-scoped - an opponent verb in an earlier clause does not make the rest of the sentence the opponent's. D05's bare 发回重审 token additionally does not fire on a heading line (a heading is a mechanical proxy, not an assertion) nor in a sentence that states the remand request has no support; an interrogative or conditional frame (是否/能否/可否/有无) inside the match's own clause states the question the answer is about to answer, not a proposition it adopts.

reproduction of the Materials: a body line whose whitespace-stripped text contains a 60-character contiguous stretch of the frozen Materials corpus is a copy of an input document, not an assertion the candidate makes, and yields no evidence span. Implements 04a section 1 (直接抄材料 must earn positive_earned 0) inside the Judge instead of by editing Materials
